about.title: Family is the first place
about.lead: Yayasan Eunike is an interdenominational Christian ministry focused on family discipleship. We partner with families so faith can be formed intentionally and passed from one generation to the next.
about.label: Our conviction
about.featureTitle: A strong church begins with a strong home.
about.featureBody: We believe parents are the primary educators and spiritual leaders of their children. Eunike exists to equip, mentor, and build supportive communities around that calling.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We keep family data with great care, especially children's data. The summary below describes the practices we plan to follow.

sections.p: Only what is needed: names, contact details, a child's date of birth, class, and photos or videos that parents upload themselves.
Children's data is limited to name, date of birth, class, and files uploaded by parents. Only the family and their class teacher can see it.
The content of counseling requests and notes can be read only by the assigned counselor. Admins and leadership cannot read it.
We ask for your consent and keep a record of it. You can request a copy or deletion of your family's data through our contact.
We only send WhatsApp messages to numbers that have agreed to receive them.
Data is stored on servers in Singapore with daily backups. Analytics, if used, are aggregate and do not track individuals.
